label: SEALED RUN: Vesper 0.8.0 on the 594 sealed G2 stars (blind)

stopped_by.text: Near a data gap or a spacecraft momentum dump
The upside-down copy has the same wiggle
Sits at a catalogue eclipse phase
Many similar dips in the same light curve
The baseline jumps across the dip
Sits on a slow ramp after data resumes
A stronger event of the other kind in the same curve

notes.text: The one-time sealed search of the 594 G2 stars has started with Vesper 0.8.0. Blind run: real and upside-down dips are mixed and not labelled until the final analysis.

stopped.what: The brightness level is different before and after, so it is a step, not a dip that comes back.
Right next to a data gap or a momentum dump. The dashed lines mark gaps. The instrument is settling there, so the dip is probably not the star.
